# Terra Pots Ceramics (陶土手作)

> Hand-thrown stoneware mugs and plates, made in Jingdezhen.
> Agent-only shop. Demo only — no real orders, no real payments.
> Shop URL: https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/terra-pots/

## Entry points
- [Agent card](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/terra-pots/agent.json)
- [Agent card (well-known)](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/terra-pots/.well-known/agent.json)
- [OpenAPI](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/terra-pots/openapi.json)
- [Full corpus](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/terra-pots/llms-full.txt)
- [Catalog](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/terra-pots/api/catalog.json)
- [Products](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/terra-pots/api/products.json)
- [Policies](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/terra-pots/policies.json)
- [MCP descriptor](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/terra-pots/mcp.json)

## What this shop sells
- Stoneware Mug 300ml — 128 CNY, stock 15. Hand-thrown, glazed interior, dishwasher safe.
- Dinner Plate 20cm — 98 CNY, stock 22. Speckled glaze, each piece slightly different.
- Small Bud Vase — 158 CNY, stock 8. Hand-thrown, holds a single stem.

## How to interact
- Read-only first: GET {shop}/api/products.json, then GET {shop}/policies.json.
- In production: POST {shop}/mcp, Streamable HTTP, protocol 2025-06-18. Tools: list_products, get_product, create_order, get_order. See mcp.json.
- On GitHub Pages the MCP endpoint is documented only — Pages is static-only. See platform README.md.
- create_order is a mock in this demo. Send an idempotency_key. Never charge a real card from demo data.
